annotations.title: Get an event in compact form

description: Use when an agent needs the current state of one prediction-market event without every field of every market: the compact form of get_event. Returns the title, venue, status, close time, the event's volume with its unit, and up to 20 outcomes (in event leader order while open, reported results first once closed), each with its probability, 24-hour change, 24-hour volume and market id; on a market whose outcomes are not Yes/No, `priced_outcome` names the outcome the price is for. Untraded markets carry no probability, and `cite_as` says when the event has no traded price. The venue's rules text appears once, for the first outcome listed. A closed event, including one archived 10 days after it closed, returns its final record with its close time, each outcome's recorded price and any reported result. It names a winner only when one is confirmed. `_meta` carries `cite_as`, `data_as_of` and links to the full record and the price history. Units: `probability`, `change_24h` and `final_price` are on a 0-1 scale (0.62 = 62%, and `change_24h` 0.05 = up 5 points). Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana. Times are UTC. Call get_event for full market rows. Before quoting an event price, check the market's `quote_tier` in `get_event` or `get_market`.

event_id.description: Event ID native to the source. URL-encoded if it contains special chars.
